data.display_address: Savanna, Dubai Creek Harbour (The Lagoons), Dubai
data.long_description:
Emaar's Savanna Residences is a premium waterfront development located in Creek Harbour, comprising three 11-storey buildings.


  Residents have access to a variety of world-class services and amenities, including outdoor pools, a gym, children's play areas, and an outdoor movie theater. At the foot of the complex is a large landscaped park with walking and biking paths and playgrounds for various sports, as well as residents can enjoy a walk along the picturesque promenade and relax on the private beach.

Savanna Residences is also within walking distance of key Dubai attractions: Ras Al Khor Nature Reserve and Dubai Creek Tower are just 5 minutes away, Dubai International Airport, Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa can be reached in 10 minutes, and Dubai Marina is a 25-minute drive away. The complex has a unique and refined architecture, with facades designed using delicate light colors. All residences have terraces or balconies that offer incredible views of the white sandy beach and the bay.

Savanna Residence is an ideal place for personal or family living. The premium apartments can also generate a stable income and have already attracted the attention of investors. Prices for waterfront residences in the area are expected to increase by 30-40% due to the construction of Dubai Square Mall - the largest in the world.
